We remain laser-focused on addressing the challenges posed by the People's Republic of China (PRC's) Government's military modernization and human rights abuses and the Russian Federation's (Russia's) efforts to obtain dual-use technologies to further its illegal, unjust, and unprovoked aggression against Ukraine. We have been navigating these immense challenges by reinvigorating our multilateral efforts and by employing export controls in new ways. Now more than ever, our work hinges on deep collaboration with allies and partners. We are also making every effort to ensure that BIS's Export Administration (EA) is positioned to successfully counter the national security challenges of the future, starting with those related to misuse of artificial intelligence (AI).
